candidates.name: contrastive_error_pair_memory
candidates.hypothesis: Storing raw wrong-prediction records (predicted label, correct label, case excerpt) and retrieving the most similar past mistakes at predict time will outperform LLM-generated lesson storage, because the model receives a structurally distinct WRONG/CORRECT signal from a directly parallel case rather than an abstract rule that may mis-generalize; this specifically targets the wrong-variant errors (e.g. 盗窃 vs 破坏电力设备, 受贿 vs 非国家工作人员受贿) that persist after iteration 1.

candidates.name: cooccurrence_scaffold_memory
candidates.hypothesis: Building an explicit charge co-occurrence graph from all training ground-truth label sets and injecting a companion-charge scaffold at predict time will reduce multi-charge under-prediction (the dominant remaining failure at ~30% of errors), because it gives the model a statistically grounded list of charges to verify against the case facts rather than requiring it to spontaneously enumerate secondary charges from examples alone.
